background: Danske Bank is Denmark's largest bank, a Nordic universal bank funded by Danish and Nordic deposits and covered bonds, lending to households and companies across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average with the weakest at A+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026 and a move to positive outlook by one on 26 Aug 2026. CET1 of 17.0% and LCR of 162% are above the EU and Nordic peer median, but leverage of 4.4% is in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 122% just below the median. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 1.6 points, leverage 0.4 points and LCR 18 points (figures to 30 Sep 2026), so the ratings have moved up while the ratios have eased.
